commit_message: Implement ADR0156 controlled benchmark campaign worker
pr_body:
## Summary

Completes the ADR 0156 controlled campaign execution bridge on the existing Draft PR. Each measured run uses a fresh machine-local fixture Editor, exact local model representation, normal AgentHost/Native Agent Runtime and typed Editor MCP, managed validation, and the ADR 0157 Play/runtime-debug/frame-capture path. Warm/cold preparation is established before measurement, campaign-start authority auto-resolves only the frozen run-scoped capabilities, measured failures are retained without retry, and sanitized ADR 0142 evidence is recorded automatically with exact campaign execution identity.

The active user project remains outside the benchmark fixture/evaluator boundary.
